slides.texte_overlay:
How to become the man
people respect without trying
Be on time, every time. Being punctual shows that you value other people's time, and they notice it. Respect starts with time.
Speak well of others. Praise people in public, give feedback in private. People trust men who don't tear others down.
Keep your emotions under control. Get angry rarely and never at the wrong person. Self-control earns deep respect.
Stand up for what's right. When someone is treated unfairly, say something calmly. Quiet courage is noticed. Speak up kindly.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Having something real to say makes people take you seriously.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Having something real to say makes people take you seriously.

slides.texte_overlay: Be good at what you do. Whatever your job, do it with care. Competence earns respect without a single word. Quality speaks.
Help without keeping score. Do favours because you want to, not to get something back. People remember generous men.
